purpose: Define the precedence and canonical home of CYNIC meta-layers so policy, contracts, runtime projections, and wrappers do not compete as source of truth.

recursion_boundary.rule: The meta-layer contract is the root contract for contract placement and precedence; no lower contract may create a competing contract-of-contracts hierarchy.
recursion_boundary.projection_rule: Domain contracts may reference this boundary and project layer vocabulary into their own domain, but they must not redefine functional layers, precedence, or canonical homes.
new_contract_admission: reuse an existing functional layer from precedence
declare whether the contract is semantic, topology, registry, kernel, MCP, organ runtime, node runtime, or wrapper projection
refuse creation when an existing contract can be extended without changing authority
forbidden: contract of contracts outside the allowed_meta_contracts list
organ runtime file becoming the source of contract authority
wrapper command creating semantics absent from policy or axioms

layers.name: policy
layers.engineering_role: Human-readable decision layer that names what the organism allows, forbids, and owns before any implementation claims authority.

layers.name: semantic_contract
layers.engineering_role: Machine-readable invariant layer that turns policy language into typed payloads, vocabularies, and validation targets.
layers.agent_question: Which JSON contract defines the vocabulary and invariant?

layers.name: topology_contract
layers.engineering_role: Filesystem and organ-boundary layer that assigns every durable source path to a lawful concern.
layers.agent_question: Where may this file live, and which boundary owns it?

layers.name: runtime_registry
layers.engineering_role: Desired-state layer for nodes, services, lifecycle targets, and agent exposure projections.
layers.agent_question: What does the organism declare should exist at runtime?

layers.name: kernel_contract
layers.engineering_role: Central nervous-system contract for durable task memory, claims, observations, health, and read-back proofs.
layers.agent_question: Which kernel endpoint or state transition proves this lifecycle step?

layers.name: mcp_surface
layers.engineering_role: Agent-facing adapter layer that exposes kernel and organism capabilities as discoverable tools.
layers.agent_question: Which MCP tool is the canonical agent interface?

layers.name: organ_runtime
layers.engineering_role: Hexagonal organ implementation layer that senses, decides locally, and acts through declared ports.
layers.agent_question: Which organ owns this behavior and through which port?
may_decide: local behavior within the declared contract

layers.name: node_runtime
layers.engineering_role: Host-local execution layer that supervises node processes, receives commands, and emits heartbeats.
layers.agent_question: Which node-local primitive executes or observes this runtime fact?

layers.name: surface_wrapper
layers.engineering_role: Ergonomic invocation layer that may wrap canonical interfaces but must not become a source of truth.
layers.agent_question: Which canonical layer does this wrapper call?
